messages:
nina_mkt: Quick sync 1: we're aiming to publish the 'Model Routing + Cost' launch post tomorrow 9:00 AM PT. Need PR embargo, CEO quote confirmation, and final assets.
sam_pr: Noted. Please share the one-line press angle and embargo time.
nina_mkt: Embargo until 9:00 AM PT. Angle: 'Redwood Inference introduces model-routing features that lower inference cost while preserving latency SLOs.'
lina_eng: Uploaded final diagrams and perf numbers to /shared/launches/model-routing. High-res svgs in the assets folder. Method blurb for press: 'We measured routing policy impact on production traces across three traffic profiles; metrics shown are p95 latency and cost-per-request.'
sam_pr: Draft CEO quote: "This feature helps teams get consistent production performance while reducing inference spend." Kevin please confirm.
kevin_ceo: Edit: make it a bit sharper: "This feature helps teams deliver consistent production performance and reduce inference spend." Approved.
support_bot: Support playbook ready: https://drive.redwood/support/playbooks/model-routing-launch-2026.pdf. Oncall rotation set for first 4 hours post-publish.
nina_mkt: Timeline: assets uploaded, CEO quote approved, embargo email out at 4:30 PM PT, blog scheduled for 9:00 AM PT. @sam_pr will you send the embargo?
sam_pr: Sending embargo to top-tier outlets at 4:30 PT and offering interviews. I'll attach Q&A.
kevin_ceo: Thanks team. Please flag any press asks that want early comment and route them to PR.
nina_mkt: Final check: CMS frontmatter flag `launch_ready=true`. I'll set it and mark staging noindex. Publishing will be handled by the deploy job.
support_bot: Deploy job created: job_id=launch-model-routing-176000, scheduled_time=1760000400, embargo=true.
nina_mkt: I'll post a final 'ready' message at 4:15 PT.
